questions.question: Three consecutive integers when taken in increasing order and multiplied by 2, 3 and 4 respectively adds up to 74. What is the greatest number?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the three consecutive integers be x, x + 1 and x + 2 respectively

According to the question

⇒ 2x + 3(x + 1) + 4(x + 2) = 74

⇒ 2x + 3x + 3 + 4x + 8 = 74

⇒ 9x + 11 = 74

⇒ 9x = 74 – 11

⇒ 9x = 63

⇒ x = 63/9

⇒ x = 7

Thus, the integers are:

First integer. = x = 7

Second integer = x + 1 = 8

Third integer = x + 2 = 9

**∴ The greatest number is 9**

questions.question: 25% of a number is 7 more than 30% of another number. The difference between the numbers is 29. What are the numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

25% of a number = 7 more than 30% of another number

Difference between the numbers = 29

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be x and y respectively

According to the question

⇒ 25/100 × x = (30/100 × y) + 7

⇒ x/4 = (3y + 70)/10

⇒ x/2 = (3y + 70)/5

⇒ 5x = 6y + 140

Now, 

(x – y) = 29

⇒ y = x – 29

Put the value in the equation we get,

⇒ 5x = 6x – 174 + 140

⇒ -x = (-34)

⇒ x = 34

(x – y) = 29

⇒ 34 – y = 29

⇒ y = 5

**∴ The numbers is 34 and 5**

questions.question: The difference between two numbers is 5. If 25 is subtracted from the smaller number and 20 is added to the greater number the ratio becomes 1 : 2. What is the greater number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial difference between the greater and smaller number = 5.

By adding 20 to the greater and subtracting 25 from the smaller, the new difference becomes: 5 + 20 − (−25) = 50.

The new ratio is 1 : 2, so the difference in ratio parts = 2 − 1 = 1 part.

Since 1 part = 50, the new greater number (which corresponds to 2 parts) = 2 × 50 = 100.

Original greater number = 100 − 20 = 80.

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between two numbers = 5

When 25 is subtracted from the smaller and 20 is added to the greater, the ratio becomes 1 : 2.

**Formula Used:**

Linear equations and ratio proportion concepts.

 Smaller Number
 Greater Number

 Ratio 1 : 2

 Equation: (x − 25) / (x + 25) = 1 / 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the smaller number be x.

⇒ Then, the greater number = x + 5

⇒ New smaller number = x − 25

⇒ New greater number = (x + 5) + 20 = x + 25

⇒ According to the question, the ratio becomes 1 : 2

⇒ (x − 25) / (x + 25) = 1 / 2

⇒ 2 × (x − 25) = 1 × (x + 25)

⇒ 2x − 50 = x + 25

⇒ 2x − x = 25 + 50

⇒ x = 75

⇒ The greater number = x + 5 = 75 + 5 = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

questions.question: If -5 is a root of the quadratic equation 2x² + px - 15 = 0 and also of the quadratic equation p(kx² + x) = 0, then what are the values of p and k?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since −5 is a root of 2x² + px − 15 = 0, substituting x = −5 gives the value of p directly.

⇒ 2(−5)² + p(−5) − 15 = 0 ⇒ 50 − 5p − 15 = 0 ⇒ 5p = 35 ⇒ p = 7

Now, substitute x = −5 and p = 7 into the second equation p(kx² + x) = 0.

⇒ 7[k(−5)² + (−5)] = 0 ⇒ 25k − 5 = 0 ⇒ 25k = 5 ⇒ k = 0.2

**∴ The correct answer is 7, 0.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First quadratic equation: 2x² + px − 15 = 0

Second quadratic equation: p(kx² + x) = 0

Root of both equations = −5

**Calculations:**

Since x = −5 is a root, it must completely satisfy the first equation.

⇒ 2(−5)² + p(−5) − 15 = 0

⇒ 2(25) − 5p − 15 = 0

⇒ 50 − 5p − 15 = 0

⇒ 35 − 5p = 0

⇒ 5p = 35

⇒ p = 7

Now, substitute x = −5 and p = 7 into the second equation.

⇒ 7[k(−5)² + (−5)] = 0

Dividing both sides by 7:

⇒ k(25) − 5 = 0

⇒ 25k = 5

⇒ k = 5 ÷ 25

⇒ k = 1/5

⇒ k = 0.2

**∴ The correct answer is 7, 0.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Roots of a Quadratic Equation

A real number α is called a root of the quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 if substituting x = α satisfies the equation (i.e., aα² + bα + c = 0).

Sum and Product of Roots

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots = −b/a and the product of roots = c/a.

Nature of Roots

Determined by the Discriminant (D = b² − 4ac). If D > 0, roots are real and distinct. If D = 0, roots are real and equal. If D < 0, roots are non-real or imaginary.

questions.question: The diagonal of a square is sqrt{200} cm. If the ratio of length and breadth of a rectangle is 5 : 2, whose area is equal to the area of ​​a square, then what is the length of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Area of the square = d² ÷ 2 = (√200)² ÷ 2 = 100 cm².

Let rectangle dimensions be 5x and 2x, so Area = 5x × 2x = 10x².

Equating areas: 10x² = 100 ⇒ x² = 10 ⇒ x = √10.

Length = 5x = 5√10 = √250 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is √250 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Diagonal of the square, d = √200 cm

⇒ Ratio of Length to Breadth of the rectangle = 5 : 2

⇒ Area of the rectangle = Area of the square

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Area of a square = d² ÷ 2

⇒ Area of a rectangle = Length × Breadth

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6afd5915f3909f3db7fb5af1e12b5dd65bb232632b1558b32471f5168240902e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the square = (√200)² ÷ 2

⇒ Area of the square = 200 ÷ 2 = 100 cm²

⇒ Let the length and breadth of the rectangle be 5x and 2x respectively.

⇒ Area of the rectangle = 5x × 2x = 10x²

⇒ Since their areas are strictly equal:

⇒ 10x² = 100

⇒ x² = 10

⇒ x = √10 cm

⇒ Length of the rectangle = 5x = 5√10 cm

⇒ Expressing 5√10 under a single square root factor: √(5² × 10) = √(25 × 10) = √250 cm

**∴ The correct answer is √250 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Area of a Square

It can be directly calculated using the side length as Area = a², or by using the diagonal length as Area = d² ÷ 2.

Rectangle Perimeter

The total length of the continuous boundary of a given rectangle is algebraically calculated as Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth).

Diagonal of a Rectangle

Both diagonals are strictly equal in length. The spatial length of each diagonal is calculated systematically using Pythagoras theorem as d = √(L² + B²).

questions.question: The average weight of a group of 20 boys was calculated to be 65 kg and it was later discovered that the weight of a boy was misread as 76 kg instead of the correct weight 66 kg. The correct average weight was:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change in weight = Correct weight − Incorrect weight

⇒ Net change = 66 − 76 = −10 kg

Change in average = Net change ÷ Total boys = −10 ÷ 20 = −0.5 kg

Correct average = Initial average + Change in average

⇒ Correct average = 65 − 0.5 = 64.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 64.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of boys (n) = 20

Calculated average weight = 65 kg

Incorrect weight read = 76 kg

Correct weight = 66 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total sum of values ÷ Total number of values

Correct Sum = Incorrect Sum − Incorrect Value + Correct Value

 
 Initial Average of 20 boys = 65 kg
 
• 
 

 
 Sum correction: 66 kg - 76 kg = -10 kg
 Average change: -10 / 20 = -0.5 kg
 
• 
 

 
 Correct Average = 64.5 kg

**Calculations:**

⇒ Incorrect sum of weights = 20 × 65 = 1300 kg

⇒ Correct sum of weights = Incorrect sum − Incorrect weight + Correct weight

⇒ Correct sum = 1300 − 76 + 66

⇒ Correct sum = 1300 − 10 = 1290 kg

⇒ Correct average = 1290 ÷ 20

⇒ Correct average = 64.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 64.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average

If group A has n₁ items with average A₁ and group B has n₂ items with average A₂, then combined average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Replacing a Member

If a new person replaces an old person and the average increases, New weight = Old weight + (Increase in average × Total members).

Including a New Member

If a new person joins the group, New value = Old Average + [Total New Members × Change in Average ÷ Total Members].
